theme: An open day, then the girls arrive.
greeting: Nothing on the calendar today, Dan — a rare clear stretch back home in St. Pete after Croatia. The girls come over tomorrow afternoon, so today is the window to close out the last travel bookings before the shuffle starts.

needsAttention.title: Close out the St. Pete gap
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 20-22 St. Pete stay is still marked open on the Mike + Dan board even though you've already landed — worth confirming where you're staying tonight before Tuesday's Orlando villa. Flagged p1, sitting since Aug 25.

needsAttention.title: Full-size SUV out of TPA
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 20-Oct 5 SUV was marked book-it-outright and you're on the ground now — if it isn't booked, tomorrow's 3 PM pickup and the Orlando drive have no vehicle for six. p1, open since Sept 9.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV, Portland
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the tightest rental in that market and sells out early; the board says book it refundable this week. p1, overdue since Sept 14.

flagged.title: Two LinkedIn messages waiting

inbox.noise: Everything else is newsletters and promos — JetBlue, NYPL, the cooking Substacks, and your Italian and Japanese dailies.

Wide open through the afternoon, with nowhere you have to be.
A quiet last evening before the girls come over tomorrow at three.
